hook.text_role: drops in mid-conversation like a clipped podcast moment
hook.visual: two hosts at mics, podcast lower-third, captions

beats.visual: two-shot of hosts, one leans into the mic
close-up of host 2 telling a personal story about the product
reaction shot of host 1, beat of silence
product on the desk between mics, end card
beats.line_role: a person's last line, not a slogan: the brief's offer, else the product plus one dry line; never 'today', never the hook again

rules: roles and patterns only - no original lines, footage, audio or likeness
